Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve. Draw ONE independently redrawn native HD transparent RGBA running animation frame, minimum1024 square. ICE SWORD GIRL NORTH, PURE BACK VIEW running AWAY from viewer. Image1 is her new HD NORTH camera, silhouette, size, identity and full-canvas registration anchor. Image2 is the user-approved bamboo girl's specific NORTH action pose only (leg/ankle/sole and arm counterbalance), NOT identity or props. Image3 is her legacy512 NORTH pose/white-blue boot reference only; rebuild real native detail, never upscale or copy it. Image4 is her definitive identity; image5 is the approved bright polished painted style.
Keep image1 head size, high bun, dark brown straight long hair, silver-blue ornaments, blue-white warm-gold robe and sash, short white blue-soled boots. Hair/robe must not hide all knees/ankles. Short rounded chibi limbs. Pure north: anatomical RIGHT is screen RIGHT holding one ice sword; anatomical LEFT is screen LEFT holding one blue talisman. Never swap hands, add hands, or rotate body into diagonal view. Arms counter-swing from true shoulders and elbows against their same-side legs, weapon angles change naturally with the wrist. Exactly two connected legs and two hands; feet along NORTH travel, no outward lateral toes.
Fixed full square canvas and camera from image1, same head/boot scale and virtual ground; anatomical support compression and bob only, never move or scale the entire figure to follow feet. Natural forward/back depth, not side splits. Full sword and all boots inside canvas. No effects, background, shadows, grid, text, blur, duplicate frame, sheet, or copied pixels. Preserve genuine transparency.

SPECIFIC NEW POSE: N16 RIGHT final landing approach before N01: RIGHT heel almost touches its N01 footprint, only a tiny visible gap, knee soft; LEFT boot raised behind with sole visible. RIGHT sword hand back at hip, LEFT talisman forward. Blend naturally toward image1 N01 without duplicating it; retain a distinct last-air pose.
